key_insight: A well-balanced WE-PINN formulation exactly preserves lake-at-rest equilibria at the discrete-residual level over smooth and discontinuous bathymetry.
engineering_relevance: The method supports mesh-free shallow-water modeling over uneven beds while preventing numerical imbalance from generating spurious flow at rest.
method: Enforce weak space–time conservation on randomly placed, potentially overlapping control volumes without differentiating the network.
Integrate the geometric source by parts and correct local bed slopes so quadrature reproduces exact bed increments.
Use independent networks across bed discontinuities, coupled by conservation of discharge and total head.
evidence_signal: Four lake-at-rest configurations achieved residuals at round-off, while seven bottom-step Riemann tests yielded relative L1 free-surface errors of 6.9×10⁻⁴–3.5×10⁻³ and recovered critical states without prescribing them.
watch_item: Exact equilibrium preservation by the residual does not guarantee rapid training convergence; network recovery to round-off required an extended training budget.
paper_title: Well-Balanced WE-PINNs for the Shallow Water Equations over Smooth and Discontinuous Bathymetries
